integrity.claim_scope: Exact finite kernels, central values, locally uniform q-channel two-point scaling, and outer-Jacobi-weight universality after center normalization.
integrity.evidence: Analytical cyclic Jacobi decomposition, endpoint identities, compact-uniform Mehler-Heine estimates and independent finite checks.
integrity.verification: Same-model proof review and numerical checker only; no independent validation.

scientific_limitations: The results require equally spaced rays, equal ray weights and real alpha,beta > -1.
The scaling result is local uniform convergence without an effective error bound.
Literature comparison is not an exhaustive claim of historical priority; classical polynomial inverse-image methods may imply special cases.
The scalar center Gamma formula is a classical Jacobi endpoint consequence of the symmetry reduction; no standalone novelty is asserted for it.
title: Branch-point Jacobi kernels on radial stars: exact Christoffel growth and a Bessel scaling limit
